translations.web: There will be a pavilion for a shade in the daytime from the heat, and for a refuge and for a shelter from storm and from rain.
translations.bsb: a shelter to give shade from the heat by day, and a refuge and hiding place from the storm and the rain.
translations.kjv: And there shall be a tabernacle for a shadow in the daytime from the heat, and for a place of refuge, and for a covert from storm and from rain.
translations.asv: And there shall be a pavilion for a shade in the day-time from the heat, and for a refuge and for a covert from storm and from rain.
